title: 语法 · 名词性从句｜句子成分与语序 · 60 句
description: 宾语、主语、表语和同位语从句；重点区分 that、what、whether、if 及间接问句。

items.zh: 我不清楚备用电源放在哪里。
items.en: I am unsure where the backup power unit is kept.
answers: I am unsure where the backup power unit is kept.
items.notes: 间接问句用陈述语序 where ... is kept。

items.zh: 请查一下哪一份记录包含原始日期。
items.en: Please check which record contains the original date.
answers: Please check which record contains the original date.
items.notes: which record 在从句中作主语，不添加 does。

items.zh: 他们没有说明为什么部分门票被取消了。
items.en: They did not explain why some tickets had been cancelled.
answers: They did not explain why some tickets had been cancelled.
They didn't explain why some tickets had been cancelled.
items.notes: why 后为陈述语序；主句过去不影响从句句型。

items.zh: 我想知道这块布是用什么材料织成的。
items.en: I wonder what this fabric is woven from.
answers: I wonder what this fabric is woven from.
items.notes: what 是 from 的宾语，介词可以留在末尾。

items.zh: 我们还不知道由谁负责最终清点。
items.en: We do not yet know who is responsible for the final count.
answers: We do not yet know who is responsible for the final count.
We don't yet know who is responsible for the final count.
items.notes: who 作主语，从句无需额外助动词。

items.zh: 你能说明我们每次最多可以借几件吗？
items.en: Could you explain how many items we may borrow at a time?
answers: Could you explain how many items we may borrow at a time?
items.notes: how many 修饰 items；we may 为陈述语序。

items.zh: 我听说他们准备重新开放观景塔。
items.en: I heard that they plan to reopen the viewing tower.
answers: I heard that they plan to reopen the viewing tower.
items.notes: that 引出陈述内容，不在从句中充当成分。

items.zh: 记录显示这扇门在检查前就损坏了。
items.en: The record shows that the door was already damaged before inspection.
answers: The record shows that the door was already damaged before inspection.
items.notes: that 从句作 shows 的宾语，不能省去主语 the door。

items.zh: 她问的是费用包括什么，而不是总共多少钱。
items.en: She asked what the fee covered, not how much it was.
answers: She asked what the fee covered, not how much it was.
items.notes: 两个宾语从句分别询问范围和金额。

items.zh: 我无法判断这段话是在陈述事实还是引用他人观点。
items.en: I cannot tell whether the passage states a fact or quotes someone else's view.
answers: I cannot tell whether the passage states a fact or quotes someone else's view.
I can't tell whether the passage states a fact or quotes someone else's view.
items.notes: whether ... or ... 连接两种备选判断。

items.zh: 是否关闭侧门，仍有待商量。
items.en: Whether to close the side entrance remains under discussion.
answers: Whether to close the side entrance remains under discussion.
items.notes: whether to do 作主语，不能用 if to do。

items.zh: 讨论取决于我们是否能找到共同的标准。
items.en: The discussion depends on whether we can find a common standard.
answers: The discussion depends on whether we can find a common standard.
items.notes: 介词 on 后用 whether，不用 if。

items.zh: 他还没决定是自己搬，还是请搬家公司。
items.en: He has not decided whether to move the furniture himself or hire movers.
answers: He has not decided whether to move the furniture himself or hire movers.
He hasn't decided whether to move the furniture himself or hire movers.
items.notes: whether + 不定式 + or；自己做与雇人形成选择。

items.zh: 问题在于那份许可是否仍有效。
items.en: The question is whether the permit remains valid.
answers: The question is whether the permit remains valid.
items.notes: whether 从句作表语，说明待判断事项。

items.zh: 是否提供大字版，不应取决于有没有人提出要求。
items.en: Whether a large-print version is provided should not depend on whether anyone requests one.
answers: Whether a large-print version is provided should not depend on whether anyone requests one.
Whether a large-print version is provided shouldn't depend on whether anyone requests one.
items.notes: 句首 whether 从句作主语；on 后的 whether 从句作介词宾语，两处均不用 if。

items.zh: 我不在乎座位是否靠窗，只要能听清就行。
items.en: I do not mind whether the seat is by a window, provided I can hear clearly.
answers: I do not mind whether the seat is by a window, provided I can hear clearly.
I don't mind whether the seat is by a window, provided I can hear clearly.
items.notes: whether 引出在乎与否的内容；provided 另表条件。

items.zh: 我们正在核实箱子是否全都到齐了。
items.en: We are checking if all the crates have arrived.
answers: We are checking if all the crates have arrived.
We are checking whether all the crates have arrived.
items.notes: check 后 if 可引导是否，也可用 whether。

items.zh: 关于合同是否应延长，双方没有达成一致。
items.en: There is no agreement on whether the contract should be extended.
answers: There is no agreement on whether the contract should be extended.
items.notes: on whether 作名词 agreement 的补足信息。

items.zh: 是不是故意遗漏了名单，需要进一步调查。
items.en: Whether the names were omitted deliberately needs further investigation.
answers: Whether the names were omitted deliberately needs further investigation.
items.notes: 句首主语从句用 whether；整体作单数主语。

items.zh: 请告诉我是否要保留封面上的日期。
items.en: Let me know whether to keep the date on the cover.
answers: Let me know whether to keep the date on the cover.
items.notes: whether to keep 省略了由语境明确的执行者。

items.zh: 谁负责保管钥匙，比钥匙放在哪个抽屉更重要。
items.en: Who keeps the key matters more than which drawer contains it.
answers: Who keeps the key matters more than which drawer contains it.
items.notes: 两个名词性从句作比较；主语从句后用 matters。

items.zh: 我们最需要的是一张标明替代入口的地图。
items.en: What we need most is a map showing alternative entrances.
answers: What we need most is a map showing alternative entrances.
items.notes: what 自身含“所……的东西”，不再加 the thing。

items.zh: 这批货是否受潮，可以通过检查内包装判断。
items.en: Whether the goods are damp can be determined by checking the inner packaging.
answers: Whether the goods are damp can be determined by checking the inner packaging.
items.notes: whether 从句作主语，谓语为 can be determined。

items.zh: 显然，两个标签指向的是同一批产品。
items.en: It is apparent that both labels refer to the same batch.
answers: It is apparent that both labels refer to the same batch.
items.notes: it 为形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句。

items.zh: 令人遗憾的是，我们只保留了裁剪后的版本。
items.en: It is unfortunate that we retained only the cropped version.
answers: It is unfortunate that we retained only the cropped version.
items.notes: it is + 形容词 + that，评价整个事实。

items.zh: 他为什么拒绝授权，目前还不清楚。
items.en: Why he refused permission is still unclear.
answers: Why he refused permission is still unclear.
items.notes: why 从句作主语，主句谓语用 is。

items.zh: 这项建议会影响多少人，尚未被计算出来。
items.en: How many people the proposal would affect has not been calculated.
answers: How many people the proposal would affect has not been calculated.
How many people the proposal would affect hasn't been calculated.
items.notes: how many people 为 affect 宾语，整个从句作单数主语。

items.zh: 重要的是每个成员都知道暂停的信号。
items.en: It matters that every member recognises the signal to pause.
answers: It matters that every member recognises the signal to pause.
items.notes: it 为形式主语；that 引出真正重要的事项。

items.zh: 令我们意外的是箱子里还有一层隔板。
items.en: What surprised us was another partition inside the box.
answers: What surprised us was another partition inside the box.
items.notes: what 作 surprised 主语，整个从句又作主句主语。

items.zh: 有人能在最后一刻接班，实在是帮了大忙。
items.en: That someone could cover the shift at the last moment was a great help.
answers: That someone could cover the shift at the last moment was a great help.
items.notes: that 引导完整事实作主语，本身不充当从句成分。

items.zh: 困难在于出口太窄，无法把整张桌子搬出去。
items.en: The difficulty is that the exit is too narrow for the whole desk.
answers: The difficulty is that the exit is too narrow for the whole desk.
items.notes: that 从句说明 difficulty 的具体内容。

items.zh: 真正的问题是我们愿意等多久。
items.en: The real issue is how long we are willing to wait.
answers: The real issue is how long we are willing to wait.
items.notes: how long 从句作表语，保持陈述语序。

items.zh: 那就是照片看起来偏蓝的原因。
items.en: That is why the photograph looks bluish.
answers: That is why the photograph looks bluish.
items.notes: why 表结果前的原因说明，不能再加 because。

items.zh: 我担心的是急着修复反而会造成更多损坏。
items.en: My concern is that a rushed repair may cause further damage.
answers: My concern is that a rushed repair may cause further damage.
items.notes: that 引出担忧内容，不应错用 what，因为从句完整。

items.zh: 我们要核实的是这道裂缝是否还在扩大。
items.en: What we need to establish is whether the crack is widening.
answers: What we need to establish is whether the crack is widening.
items.notes: what 主语从句与 whether 表语从句各有功能。

items.zh: 争议不在于要不要清洁，而在于谁支付费用。
items.en: The dispute is not whether cleaning is needed but who pays for it.
answers: The dispute is not whether cleaning is needed but who pays for it.
The dispute isn't whether cleaning is needed but who pays for it.
items.notes: 两个表语从句用 not ... but ... 对照。

items.zh: 我的理解是借用期可以续一次。
items.en: My understanding is that the loan can be renewed once.
answers: My understanding is that the loan can be renewed once.
items.notes: that 引出理解的完整内容；once 表次数。

items.zh: 他们认为最重要的，正是我们最先忽略的。
items.en: What they considered most important was what we overlooked first.
answers: What they considered most important was what we overlooked first.
items.notes: 两个 what 从句分别作主语和表语。

items.zh: 这就是控制线必须保持完整的原因。
items.en: This is why the control cable must remain intact.
answers: This is why the control cable must remain intact.
items.notes: why 从句作表语；intact：完整未断的。

items.zh: 问题似乎是谁都以为别人已经检查过。
items.en: The problem seems to be that everyone assumed someone else had checked.
answers: The problem seems to be that everyone assumed someone else had checked.
items.notes: seems to be 后接 that 表语从句。

items.zh: 有消息说渡轮可能暂停一天。
items.en: There is news that the ferry may stop running for a day.
answers: There is news that the ferry may stop running for a day.
items.notes: that 从句解释 news 的内容，不是修饰一个缺成分的句子。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 他们拒绝了必须立即签字的要求。
items.en: They rejected the demand that they sign immediately.
answers: They rejected the demand that they sign immediately.
items.notes: demand 后同位语从句用动词原形 sign。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 我们没有证据表明涂层已经失效。
items.en: We have no evidence that the coating has failed.
answers: We have no evidence that the coating has failed.
items.notes: that 内容完整，说明 evidence 所支持的命题。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 导游没有兑现带我们参观塔楼的承诺。
items.en: The guide did not fulfil the promise that we would visit the tower.
answers: The guide did not fulfil the promise that we would visit the tower.
The guide didn't fulfil the promise that we would visit the tower.
items.notes: that 从句说明 promise 内容，不在从句中作宾语。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 认为价格越高质量就一定越好的想法值得怀疑。
items.en: The idea that higher prices always mean better quality is questionable.
answers: The idea that higher prices always mean better quality is questionable.
items.notes: that 引导 idea 的同位语从句；主句主语中心为 idea。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 他们听到了一个关于旧桥将被保留的传闻。
items.en: They heard a rumour that the old bridge would be retained.
answers: They heard a rumour that the old bridge would be retained.
items.notes: rumour that + 完整句子，说明传闻内容。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 我们需要回答谁来承担运费的问题。
items.en: We need to answer the question of who will cover shipping.
answers: We need to answer the question of who will cover shipping.
items.notes: of 后接 who 从句，具体解释 question。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 她提出的假设尚未经过试验。
items.en: The assumption that she proposed remains untested.
answers: The assumption that she proposed remains untested.
items.notes: that 作 proposed 的宾语，此处是定语从句，不是同位语从句。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 设备必须停机的事实改变了我们的安排。
items.en: The fact that the equipment must be shut down changes our plans.
answers: The fact that the equipment must be shut down changes our plans.
items.notes: that 从句解释 fact 的内容；主句动词 changes 与 fact 一致。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 我同意先试用一个月的建议。
items.en: I agree with the suggestion that we try it for a month first.
answers: I agree with the suggestion that we try it for a month first.
items.notes: suggestion 后内容从句用原形 try；with 属于 agree 的搭配。
tags: 同位语内容与定语区分

items.zh: 请把你认为有用的东西留下。
items.en: Keep whatever you consider useful.
answers: Keep whatever you consider useful.
items.notes: whatever 作 consider 的宾语，指任何你认为有用之物。

items.zh: 谁先完成，就由谁去核对清单。
items.en: Whoever finishes first should check the inventory.
answers: Whoever finishes first should check the inventory.
items.notes: whoever 在从句中作主语，整个从句作主句主语。

items.zh: 你可以选择最适合窗口大小的那一款。
items.en: You may choose whichever fits the window best.
answers: You may choose whichever fits the window best.
items.notes: whichever 指限定选项中的任意一个，在从句中作主语。

items.zh: 我相信的是能够复核的内容。
items.en: I trust what can be checked independently.
answers: I trust what can be checked independently.
items.notes: what 作从句主语，同时整个从句作 trust 的宾语。

items.zh: 把副本交给你认为负责存档的人。
items.en: Give the copy to whoever you think handles the archive.
answers: Give the copy to whoever you think handles the archive.
items.notes: whoever 作 handles 主语，不能因前有 to 就改成 whomever。

items.zh: 他们记录了自己能记起的所有细节。
items.en: They recorded whatever details they could recall.
answers: They recorded whatever details they could recall.
items.notes: whatever details 作 recall 的宾语，说明不限具体细节。

items.zh: 你最终选什么，都需要在表上注明。
items.en: Whatever you eventually choose needs to be entered on the form.
answers: Whatever you eventually choose needs to be entered on the form.
items.notes: whatever 从句作主语，主句用 needs。

items.zh: 我不能承诺超出设备能力的事情。
items.en: I cannot promise more than what the equipment can deliver.
answers: I cannot promise more than what the equipment can deliver.
I can't promise more than what the equipment can deliver.
items.notes: what 作 deliver 宾语；more than 限定承诺范围。

items.zh: 请确认从机器里取出来的确实是正确的零件。
items.en: Check that what comes out of the machine is the correct component.
answers: Check that what comes out of the machine is the correct component.
items.notes: that 宾语从句内部含 what 主语从句。

items.zh: 我们更在意作品表达了什么，而不是作者是谁。
items.en: We care more about what the work expresses than who created it.
answers: We care more about what the work expresses than who created it.
items.notes: 两个名词性从句分别回答内容与作者。
